This PR implements the DynamicMPT amendment (XLS-94d) that allows issuers to mutate Multi-Purpose Token (MPT) properties after creation. The amendment enables modification of metadata, transfer fees, and specific flags that control token behavior.

- Adding support for mutable flags that control which properties can be changed post-creation

- Adding comprehensive validation to ensure only authorized mutations are allowed

issues.title: MPTokenIssuanceSet delegates can bypass permission checks for DynamicMPT mutation operations
issues.author: RomThpt
issues.body:
## Summary

`MPTokenIssuanceSet::checkPermission()` only validates granular delegate permissions for `tfMPTLock` and `tfMPTUnlock` flags. When `featureDynamicMPT` is enabled, the transaction can also carry mutation fields (`sfMutableFlags`, `sfMPTokenMetadata`, `sfTransferFee`, `sfDomainID`), but these are not checked in the granular permission path. A delegate with *any* permission can submit a mutation-only transaction (no Lock/Unlock flags) and it will fall through to `return tesSUCCESS`, bypassing authorization.
